verdict.rationale: Paxos docs state that it publishes monthly reserve-composition reports and attestation reports for USDG, and that USDG is fully redeemable 1:1 for USD, which covers the reserve and attestation part of the story. The pack has no evidence of a yield or rewards program, its eligibility, or regulatory caveats. Missing for 10: any documented yield/rewards program with eligibility and regulatory caveats, detail on reserve composition beyond a single mention, and independent corroboration.
